dialogue.speaker: Neighbor

glosses.meaning: a special day or a time without work

dialogue.en: Which special day do you like most?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I love New Year. Our family gathers for a big dinner.
dialogue.en: I like New Year. My family comes together for a big meal.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Do you decorate the house?

glosses.meaning: to make a place look nice

dialogue.en: That is nice. Do you make the house pretty?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, we decorate it, and we give small gifts.

glosses.meaning: to make a place look nice

dialogue.en: Yes, we make it pretty and we give small presents.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.text: What other traditions do you have?
dialogue.en: What other customs does your family have?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We watch fireworks together. How do you celebrate?

glosses.meaning: to do something special for a happy day

dialogue.en: We watch fireworks as a family. How do you celebrate?

practice_words.tip: Say SEL-uh-brate: stress the first part
Say truh-DISH-un: stress the second part
